study: Gore et al. 2021, Quality Teaching Rounds (QTR) RCT, Teaching and Teacher Education 101
delivery_evidence: Teachers attended a two-day (12 h) in-service QT/QTR workshop plus four in-school PD days, then ran QTR in school-based PLCs; all face-to-face (Method, 'two-day workshop and four in-school PD days'). Applies to both extracted arms (researcher-led and trainer-led).
test_alignment_evidence: Outcomes are ACER Progressive Achievement Tests (PAT-M, PAT-R, PAT-Science)—broad independent standardized achievement tests, not aligned to QTR content (Table 6, p.9).
curriculum_evidence: QTR is a generic pedagogy-focused PD (Quality Teaching model) used to analyze lessons across any subject; no new curriculum or materials adopted by teachers (Intervention description; 'pedagogy-focused approach').
outcome_timing_evidence: All effect sizes from the 8-month follow-up (Term 4 2019), the end-of-treatment wave for Cohort 1; no later waves in this report (Table 6; design description).
